uncertain: total_required_credits (35.0) is the sum of the required_credits of all groups. The three MGMT options (Consulting, Corporate Social Responsibility and Sustainability, Human Resources) are mutually exclusive additional requirements ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'); they are included in the total, but a student would complete at most one option. The major core alone is 4+4+3+9 = 20 credits.
The Consulting Option block allows a 3-4 credit choice; the lower bound (3) is used in the calculated total.
